=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text hay "tacoloco"
text nd "co"
text tst "starts with: "
text tct "found at:"
text ten "ends with: "
text tyes "yes"
text tno "no"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn emitb b bool to void
if b
emit tyes
else
emit tno
end
end
note at tells whether t occurs in s at offset i (false when it would run past the end)
fn at2 s view uchar * t view uchar * i ulong to bool
if gt add i len t len s
ret false
end
for j ulong len t
if ne get s add i j get t j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn main to int
emit tst
emitb at2 hay nd 0
emit nl
emit tct
for i ulong len hay
if at2 hay nd i
emit sp
emitu i
end
end
emit nl
emit ten
emitb at2 hay nd sub len hay len nd
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
starts with: no
found at: 2 6
ends with: yes
</pre>
